description: AICTIONBOT™ Spend Cube by KULIC Advisory. Takes the rows of a spend, invoice or order export and returns total volume, documents and suppliers, how many suppliers carry 80 % of the volume, the top 10 suppliers with their share, volume by category with a suggested category where none is given, small orders under a threshold, rows without an order number, possible duplicate postings, categories bought from three or more suppliers (bundling) and the tail X-ray: who carries the last 5 % of volume, one-time suppliers and a suitable channel per category. Column names in German or English are recognised. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Requests without sign-in are limited to 20 KB.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

rows.description: Spend rows as objects: supplier (Lieferant) and amount (Betrag, net) are required; date (Datum), category (Warengruppe), order_no (Bestellnummer) and description (Beschreibung) are optional.

small_order_threshold.description: Small order threshold in EUR. Default 250.

name: analyse_spend
title: Analyse a spend or order export: who carries the volume, small orders, bundling, tail and possible duplicate postings
